name: modern-ensure-savings-m1001
finalText:
Member M-1001 (Anna Kovalenko) now has a Savings sub-account, M-1001-S1. I created it because none existed.

- **Before:** her customer details page said "Sub-accounts: none". The checking balance was $2,450.75.
- **Action:** I opened a sub-account, chose Savings and clicked Continue. The confirmation read "Sub-account M-1001-S1 (Savings) opened for Anna Kovalenko. Simulated — no real transaction."
- **After:** I went back to her customer page. It now says "Sub-accounts: M-1001-S1 (Savings)", and there is only one.

The site labels the transaction as simulated, so no real account was opened.
